military_unit: the Fian of the Red Branch

morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic [quality|feature](stem) + element (Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height) layered over Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god], Niut-[god], Ta-[noun]): the capital Mag Itru (the river-plain), Per-Toran (temple-city of Toran), Ta-Orlann (the iron-land).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling stock keep the Mac- (son of) / O-Ua (descendant of) patronymic and the cland/fine kin-group; the Egyptian populace keep the 'sa-' (son of) filiation and theophoric constructs; the throne fuses both - a ri who also carries a Per- house-name.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried per-temples and fallen raths: 'the Tomb of Nesut [name]', 'the Sunken Per-netjer', 'the Rath of the Hound'
patterns.military_units: the [cland] Fian (warrior-band) and the temple divisions: 'the Fian of the Red Branch', 'the Standard of Orlann', 'the Division of Tjuraa', 'the Hound-spears'
patterns.ships: curach river-boats and war-barques: 'Barque of Toran', 'the Grey Hound', 'Raven of the Itru'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - CELTIC (Insular / Goidelic) reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set), Egyptian morphs SECONDARY (the abydosian deity-morphs), never real Celtic/Egyptian gods. All three alignments: the Lawful keep the sun-and-oath powers, the Neutral the ancestral war-dead and the land and river powers, the Chaotic the war-fury and raven powers; the druidic drui/fili and the Egyptian hem-netjer mediate side by side.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers keep their morphs + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power; warded at the cairn and framed as -kin of the great serpent Hefau): Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Fire (Eg. Marakhu the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Eg. Wakedjet, the Devouring Hefau); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm.

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the black alluvial field beneath the temple-pylon
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron spear crossed with a torc (oath-ring) and the river-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a triskele sun-wheel over the feather of right-order

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or Per-netjer (Egyptian god's-house) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Tuath-de (the god-kin) and the ancestral heroes of the ruling cland (honored at the cairn and the holy well) and the akhu / justified dead (maa-kheru) of the river-kingdom, venerated at the tomb-temples and the per-netjer.

Delorum.gloss: death, the rest of the dead, lord of the peaceful dead

Gaiandus.gloss: the enduring land, the black alluvial earth

Tulrius.gloss: the sun, the just brightness and right-order

religion.the_one: Eternan (Eg. Atjernaa) - the Ancient One beyond the god-kin, the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the war-fury and the raven - and names the Lawful powers, and Eternan, as the tyrant-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan, Toran the just (the sun above the feather of right-order), Orlann of the sworn oath-war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as the warded ill-kin (Goid. namnamed at the cairn; Eg. framed as -kin of the great serpent Hefau), unworshipped; the fian's sworn oath and the just over-king are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the deified heroes of the ruling cland and the Tuath-de) and the akhu / justified dead of the per-temples and the river-land; the great powers invoked at the nemed-grove and the per-netjer situationally rather than worshipped wholesale

titles._tiers_note: Insular Celtic (Goidelic) ladder, ascending, with the Egyptian substrate co-titles beneath. Aire (noble) barony; Maor (warden) march; Toisech (sept-chief) county over a Toisecht; Flaith (lord) duchy over a Flaithes; Ri Tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality; Ruiri (over-king) kingdom - the enthroned Celtic over-king who assumed the Egyptian throne, displayed as Pharaoh - over a Morthuath; Ard-ri Nesut (the high-king; Goid. ard-ri + Eg. nesut) empire over the Ard-rige. The conquered river-cities keep their Egyptian sepati (nomarch) and hem-netjer (priest) beneath the Goidelic crown; the per-aa style survives as the highest sacral honorific of the enthroned ruiri. The brithem (judge) and fili (poet-seer), and the Egyptian wab and hem-netjer, stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Egyptian registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Goidelic war-aristocracy over the Egyptian river-kingdom: the ri and his flaith-kin at the crown, the toisech-chiefs over the niut-cities, the fian-spears sworn to the war-host; the hem-netjer priesthood and the scribal per-aat serve beneath)
titles.heir: Tanaiste (the heir-elect / second); Sa-Nesut (king's son, Egyptian style)
